html:
Indira Gandhi was prime minister of India from 1966 to 1977 and from 1980 until she was killed in 1984. She was India's first and so far only woman prime minister.

She was the only child of Jawaharlal Nehru. Party bosses of the Congress chose her in 1966, thinking she would be easy to steer. She broke with them, nationalised the big banks and won the 1971 election on the slogan "remove poverty".

Her high points came soon after. India's victory in the Bangladesh Liberation War of 1971 split Pakistan. The Green Revolution made India self sufficient in grain, and in 1974 India tested a nuclear device, Smiling Buddha.

When a court voided her election, she declared the Emergency of 1975 to 1977, jailed opponents and censored the press. She lost the 1977 election, then came back in 1980.

In June 1984 she sent the army into the Golden Temple at Amritsar to remove armed Sikh militants, Operation Blue Star. In October two of her Sikh bodyguards shot her dead, and riots against Sikhs followed in Delhi.
sum: Indira Gandhi was prime minister of India from 1966 to 1977 and from 1980 until she was killed in 1984. She was India's first and so far only woman prime minister.
